sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:44

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:44:1
items.html: And so is the matter in all the VAK, etc., they turn their faces and illuminate downward: Namely as written above, that this Hey emerged through a coupling of the male and female of the vessel of Bina. And at the time when Bina refined from phase two to phase one in order to give the light of Hesed into the vessel of Hesed, then this light of the Hey emerged with it as well, and Hesed gave her to Gvura, and so on, until she reached the vessel of Hod, and Hod gave her to Yesod. And this is what he says, “and so is the matter in all the VAK: when the lights are given into them, they turn their faces and illuminate downward” — that is, that same light of the Hey that emerged through a coupling, whose bestowal the ARI always calls by the name of “illumination,” as above.
